claim: The co-op MCU and Delta 2B part 2 native loader crashes are diagnosed, corrected at their source-bound skeleton-family boundaries and pass focused minimized GPL-dedicated loads; Hellhole's remaining inherited Imp declaration collision is patched and awaits rebuilt native validation.

hellhole_1_pre_fix.failure: stock map_hellhole.def inherited the private 41-joint Xbox Imp mesh but retained the public 71-joint impcyberwakeup animation
hellhole_1_pre_fix.fix_status: builder and regression test patched; rebuilt native result pending

findings.mcu: When a derived declaration replaces an inherited mesh, the engine retains inherited numeric channel-joint indices. Re-declare torso and legs channels by joint name after selecting the private Xbox mesh.
findings.delta2b_2: The public-source-bound 50-joint Xbox ZCT family must outrank an older generated private 63-joint alias during replay.
findings.hellhole_1: Shadow and narrowly retarget the hellhole_imp cybercrawl declaration so its animation and mesh remain in the same private 41-joint Xbox Imp family.

limits: Hellhole's patched declaration must pass a rebuilt focused native load before acceptance.
